values.name: Express
values.description: Express treatment (if by rail, legal express regime for parcels transport).

values.name: High speed
values.description: Transport under legal international rail convention (CIM) concluded between rail organizations and based on fast routing and specified timetables.

values.name: Normal speed
values.description: Transport under legal international rail convention (CIM) concluded between rail organizations.

values.name: Post service
values.description: Transport under conditions specified by UPU (Universal Postal Union) and Rail organizations (parcels transport only).
